human_verdict.critical_legal_fields: Paddle preserved the resolution identifiers and principal legal sentences more reliably; Tesseract produced repeated numeral, proper-name, and legal-noun substitutions.
human_verdict.layout: Paddle retained paragraph order and line grouping better, but all engines need a cleanup pass for seals, signatures, headers, and stamps.
human_verdict.runtime: Paddle 407.82 seconds for 10 pages versus Tesseract fast 91.33 seconds and best 98.26 seconds, approximately 4.5x slower than Tesseract.
human_verdict.decision: Do not replace production OCR yet. Promote Paddle only as a candidate engine for a 120-200 page representative gold set, with the original OCR preserved and page-level provenance recorded.
